history.notes: Initial release candidate: a dealer utility surface that authorizes and records privileged maintenance work · Three project-labelled privileged tasks, each authorized as its own Control4 event; the driver performs no maintenance itself · Three confirmation regimes (Two-Step Confirm, Code Confirm with a printed one-time code, Immediate) behind a bounded confirmation window that keeps its original schedule once armed · Maintenance Lock that refuses every privileged request and clears anything pending; persisted across reboots · Persistent ring-buffer audit log with an optional JSON webhook per entry plus a full-log export; clearing the log is itself confirmed and leaves a tombstone · MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing on every privileged path; read-only diagnostics stay available unlicensed
